subtopics.content: Responsibility for computer failure.
subtopics.objective: Understand ethical issues relating to responsibility for computer failure.

subtopics.content: Definition of computer security and its types: network security, internet or cybersecurity, application security, data security, information security, and end-user security.
subtopics.objective: Define computer security and identify different types of computer security and their characteristics.

subtopics.content: Security tools, including firewalls, antivirus software, and encryption.
subtopics.objective: Identify appropriate security tools for different types of computer security.

subtopics.content: Categories of application threats, including input threats, authorisation threats, session-management threats, and parameter tampering.
subtopics.objective: Identify categories of application threats and explain their characteristics.

subtopics.content: Basic dimensions of information security: confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA).
subtopics.objective: Identify the basic dimensions of information security.

subtopics.content: Network security issues, including unauthorised intrusion and rules and configurations that protect confidentiality, integrity, and accessibility through software and hardware.
subtopics.objective: Identify network security issues and explain how network security protects confidentiality, integrity, and accessibility.

subtopics.content: Network security methods: antivirus software, application security, behavioural analytics, data loss prevention, email security, firewalls, mobile device security, network segmentation, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), web security, wireless security, and Network Access Control (NAC).
subtopics.objective: Mention network security methods.

subtopics.content: Cybersecurity threats, including cybercrime, cyberattacks, cyberterrorism, malware, viruses, Trojans, spyware, ransomware, adware, botnets, SQL injection, phishing, man-in-the-middle attacks, denial-of-service attacks, Dridex, romance scams, and Emotet malware.
subtopics.objective: List different types of cybersecurity threats.

subtopics.content: Cybersecurity safety tips: regularly updating software and operating systems, using antivirus software, using strong passwords, avoiding email attachments from unknown senders, avoiding suspicious links and unfamiliar websites, and avoiding unsecured public Wi-Fi networks.
subtopics.objective: Identify and apply basic cybersecurity safety practices.

topics.title: Potentials for Higher Studies in Computing

subtopics.content: Career paths in computing: software developer, software test engineer, programme analyst, system developer, web developer, software development engineer, computer systems analyst, database administrator, system administrator, systems engineer, network engineer, business analyst, programme manager, IT specialist, data analyst, data scientist, AI and robotics specialist, systems security analyst, digital forensic analyst, mobile app developer, ICT manager, blogger, e-marketer, social media manager, ICT educator, academic careers, private entrepreneurship, internet police, IT user support or desk officer, ICT librarian, and computer instructor.
subtopics.objective: List possible career paths in computing.
